name: Cá kho mặn
summary: Cá kho mặn is fish braised salty, listed apart from the light braise. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study puts both in the daily rice and says the kitchen uses little spice. No salt measure and no stall price were printed.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.
The study does not name a fish. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Cá kho mặn — salty braised fish, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Fish braised salty for the daily rice on Tân Hiệp, listed apart from the light braise. A stall price is Check on arrival.
